paper-workorder-photo-to-invoice.name: Paper work order → photo → sent to AI → invoice draft created in {logiciel}
paper-workorder-photo-to-invoice.description: You take a photo of the work order and the invoice gets prepared without retyping.
after_flow: You take a photo of the work order
The invoice goes to the client

steps.text: When the job is done, you take a photo of the work order and send it by text or email. No app to install.
AI picks up the client, the job site address, the hours, the materials and the work order number, even when they're handwritten.
Each line is checked against your price list and hourly rates. A mismatch or missing detail is flagged right away.
An invoice draft is created in {logiciel}, with the photo of the work order attached as backup.
You get the list of drafts to approve. One click, and the invoice goes to the client.

exceptions.handling: The photo is rejected right away and you get a text asking you to retake it.
The work order is set aside with the closest client suggested. Nothing is created until you confirm.
The work order number is checked before anything is created. A work order that was already invoiced is blocked.
Unusual hours or quantities are flagged before approval.

delivery-proof-to-invoice.name: Signed proof of delivery received → automation starts → invoice draft created in {logiciel}
delivery-proof-to-invoice.description: The signed proof of delivery triggers the freight invoice, at the right rate.
after_flow: The driver sends the signed proof
The invoice goes to the client

steps.text: The driver takes a photo of the signed proof of delivery, or it arrives by email.
AI picks up the client, the bill of lading number, the date, the weight or pallet count, and checks the signature.
The rate is checked against the rate confirmation or your rate sheet. Waiting and handling charges noted on the proof are added.
An invoice draft is created in {logiciel}, with the proof of delivery attached.
You approve the day's invoices in one go, and they go out to the clients.

exceptions.handling: The proof is rejected and the dispatcher is notified before it gets invoiced.
The difference is shown next to the line before approval.

exceptions.case: Same bill of lading received twice
exceptions.handling: A number that was already invoiced is blocked.
They're picked up from the proof and added as lines to approve.

email-po-to-invoice-draft.name: Purchase order received by email → automation starts → invoice draft created in {logiciel}
email-po-to-invoice-draft.description: Orders you receive by email become invoice drafts without retyping.
after_flow: You receive a purchase order by email
The invoice goes to the client

steps.text: Purchase orders that land in your inbox, as a PDF or in the body of the email, are picked out automatically.
AI picks up the client, the product numbers, the quantities, the agreed prices and the requested delivery date.
Products and prices are checked against your catalogue and price list. An order received twice is blocked.
An invoice draft is created in {logiciel}, ready as soon as the order is delivered.
You approve, and the invoice goes to the client with their purchase order number as a reference.

exceptions.handling: The line is flagged with the closest product in your catalogue, and you choose.
The difference is shown next to the line before approval.
The purchase order number is checked. A duplicate doesn't create a second invoice.
It's ignored and stays in your inbox as usual.

excel-quote-to-job-to-invoice.name: Excel quote → automation starts → invoice draft created in {logiciel}
excel-quote-to-job-to-invoice.description: The accepted quote becomes the invoice when the job is done, without retyping the lines.
after_flow: Your team marks the job done
The invoice goes to the client
human_steps: Your team marks the job done

steps.text: Your quotes stay in Excel, in the same folder and with the same template as today.
Your team marks the job done, on their phone or in your calendar.
AI then reads the accepted quote: client, lines, quantities and prices, even if the template changes from one quote to the next.
An invoice draft is created in {logiciel} from the quote, with extras added along the way and deposits already invoiced taken off.
You approve, and the invoice goes out the same day the job is done.

exceptions.case: Quote changed after it was accepted
exceptions.handling: The latest version is used and the differences from the accepted version are shown.
Columns are recognized by their heading. A file that isn't recognized is set aside for you.
The draft isn't created and you get a notice to create or match the client.
Amounts already invoiced are taken off the draft.

portal-orders-to-monthly-invoice.name: Client portal orders → grouped by client → invoice created in {logiciel}
portal-orders-to-monthly-invoice.description: Orders from your clients' portals are grouped into one invoice per client at the end of the month.
after_flow: The client orders on their portal
The invoices go to the clients

steps.text: Every day, new orders are pulled from your clients' portals, with no copy and paste.
AI reads the orders, whatever the portal looks like, and picks up the client, the products, the quantities and the order numbers.
Orders are sorted by client, and cancelled, changed or already invoiced orders are caught.
At the end of the month, one invoice per client is prepared in {logiciel}, with the detail of each order.
You approve all of the month's invoices in one go.

exceptions.handling: Pulling orders stops and you're notified, instead of creating wrong invoices.
The latest version in the portal is used at invoicing time.
An order number can only appear on one invoice.
The order is set aside until the client is matched.

text-screenshot-to-invoice.name: Text message → screenshot → sent to AI → invoice created in {logiciel}
text-screenshot-to-invoice.description: A screenshot of the client's text is enough: AI turns it into the invoice.
after_flow: The invoice goes to the client

steps.text: When a client orders by text, you take a screenshot and send it to a dedicated number or address. Nothing else changes for you or for them.
AI reads the screenshot: client, products, quantities, requested date. If something is missing, you're told right away.
The order is checked against your clients and products.
An invoice is created in {logiciel}, ready to approve.
You approve, and the invoice goes to the client.

exceptions.handling: You get a notice to send another one, and nothing is invoiced.
The order waits until you create or match the client.
The second one is recognized and ignored.

exceptions.case: Order changed by a second text
exceptions.handling: The new screenshot replaces the first one before approval.

invoice-on-completion.name: Job marked done → invoice sent the same day
invoice-on-completion.description: As soon as a job is done, the invoice goes out the same day instead of waiting for month end.
after_flow: Your team marks the job done
The invoice goes out the same day

steps.text: Your team marks the job done in one click, on their phone or in your calendar.
Hours, materials and the agreed price are pulled from what already exists: the quote, the work order or the calendar.
An invoice draft is created in {logiciel} within the hour.
Each evening, you get the list of drafts to approve.
Approved invoices go out the same day, not at the end of the month.

exceptions.handling: The draft waits and the person responsible gets a reminder.
You get a reminder the next morning.
An add-on or a credit note is prepared instead of a second invoice.

payment-follow-up.name: Unpaid invoice → automatic reminders at 15, 30 and 45 days
payment-follow-up.description: Payment reminders go out on their own and stop as soon as the invoice is paid.
after_flow: You call if it's still unpaid
human_steps: You call if it's still unpaid

steps.text: Every morning, unpaid invoices are checked in {logiciel}.
Each reminder is written in your company's name, with the invoice number and a payment link if you have one.
A polite reminder goes out at 15 days, a firmer one at 30 days and a last one at 45 days.
As soon as a payment is recorded in {logiciel}, the reminders stop.
At 45 days, you get the list of clients to call, with the reminder history.

exceptions.case: Client paid, payment not recorded yet
exceptions.handling: The balance is checked the morning of each reminder, and the client can reply that they paid.
You mark it as disputed and it's taken out of the reminders.

exceptions.case: Good client who always pays at 45 days
exceptions.handling: You can exclude them or push back their reminders.
